name: 模拟炸弹爆炸和掉落箱子
englishName: Simulate Bomb Explosions and Falling Boxes
hints: Determine which bombs explode using the grid at the beginning of each second. How can you mark boxes for destruction without affecting the other bombs?
After processing explosions, simulate gravity from the bottom row upward so that each non-static box falls by exactly one row.
Consider how far each box can fall before being destroyed or becoming static. Show that the grid stabilizes after at most n seconds, so simulating 10<sup>100</sup> seconds is unnecessary.
